notes: Partition verified: all 12 source and all 15 target IDs are covered exactly once across the 11 units, heads all in-array.
τὸν πονηρόν follows rule 102: the article takes the discontinuous *the … man* and the adjective keeps a bare *wicked*.
ὑμῶν αὐτῶν is joined into one unit because a single English word spells both tokens (rule 39); the head is the only target token.

ἐξάρατε keeps *away* while ἐξ takes *from among*: rule 106 strands the extra particle on the verb because *from among* is a complete prepositional expression that does not itself carry the preverb's sense — the contrast with 5:10's *go* / *out of*, where *out* is part of ἐκ's own gloss.
ὁ before θεός is unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner for it.
